parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID. For more information about how to obtain an image ID, see [ListImages](~~449118~~).

parameters.name: LabelFilter
parameters.description:
The filter conditions for labels. Separate multiple conditions with commas.
The format for a single condition is `key=value`.
This parameter works independently of the LabelKeys parameter.

parameters.name: LabelKeys
parameters.description:
The list of tag keys. Separate multiple keys with commas (,).
System tags start with "system". This parameter works independently of the LabelFilter parameter.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region where the image resides.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
